meta.name: to-issues
meta.description: Break a plan, spec, or PRD into independently-grabbable issues on the project issue tracker using tracer-bullet vertical slices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将计划或需求拆解为可独立领取的议题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需将大需求拆成可执行的小任务
copy.tagline_en: Break plans or specs into independently assignable issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to break down large requirements into actionable tasks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会把你的计划、规格或产品需求文档拆成一个个可以独立领取的小任务（垂直切片），发布到项目的问题跟踪器上。
howto.when: 当你给 Claude 一个计划、规格或 PRD，或者提供一个现有问题的引用（编号、URL 或路径）时触发。

say.text: 把这个 PRD 拆成可领取的任务。
say.note: Claude 会分析 PRD 并生成任务列表。

say.text: 把这份计划分解成垂直切片。
say.note: Claude 会按垂直切片规则拆分计划。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude breaks your plan, spec, or PRD into independently-grabbable issues (vertical slices) and publishes them to the project issue tracker.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a plan, spec, or PRD, or an issue reference (number, URL, or path).

say_en.text: Break this PRD into grabbable tasks.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the PRD and generate a task list.

say_en.text: Decompose this plan into vertical slices.
say_en.note: Claude will split the plan following vertical slice rules.
